hall.name: The Great Hall
hall.previous_hall: West Hall (used historically until capacity expansion)

seating_types.location: Floor area in front of the stage / oche
seating_types.description: Long banquet tables seating 6-10 people. Highly social, active fan atmosphere, closest proximity to player walk-on walkaways.

seating_types.location: Rear and raised flanks of the Great Hall
seating_types.description: Raked tiered stadium-style seating providing clear, elevated sightlines over the floor tables toward the giant screens and stage oche.
Dedicated wheelchair user and companion positions with step-free entry via Palm Court.

security_and_entry.bag_size_limit: Max 30cm x 20cm x 10cm (small handbags only; large backpacks and luggage prohibited)
security_and_entry.luggage_policy: Strictly no large suitcases, roller bags, or bulky backpacks allowed inside the venue. No external cloakroom luggage storage on site.
security_and_entry.re_entry: No re-entry permitted once admitted to the venue.
security_and_entry.age_restriction: Under 16s must be accompanied by an adult aged 21 or over.
prohibited_items: Hard plastic, metal or wooden prop weapons
Full-face covering masks or helmets (security ID verification)
Football club shirts, scarves, or political partisan banners
Inflatable toys exceeding 1 meter or obstructing spectator sightlines
Glass, cans, outside alcohol, and unsealed food/drinks
Professional cameras with detachable lenses or audio recording rigs
Flares, smoke canisters, fireworks, whistles, or air horns

transport_links.distance: 1.2 miles (approx. 20-25 min uphill walk or 8 min via W3 bus)
0.6 miles (approx. 10-15 min uphill walk through palace grounds)

transport_links.connecting: Finsbury Park station to Alexandra Palace Palm Court stop directly at the main entrance

food_and_drink.bars: Multiple dedicated high-volume bars located in the Palm Court and inside the Great Hall
food_and_drink.signature_features: 4-pint beer pitchers, reusable souvenir stack cups, quick-pour draught taps
food_and_drink.on_site_dining: The Phoenix Bar & Kitchen, Palm Court street-food market traders
food_and_drink.payment_policy: Strictly card and contactless payments only. Cash is not accepted at venue bars or food counters.
